description: Team HELION is a high-school team from Edirne, Türkiye, joining the Ankara event (hybrid). We are three students, with skills in software, electronics, and design. We are building health monitoring software for astronauts on long space missions: it gathers health indicators and helps astronauts evaluate their health status and act on it in time. Our team is complete, but we are happy to connect with other teams and mentors!
